changelog: Two things. A break no longer needs anybody to type how long a trailer or advert is: the schedule works out how much of the video actually plays - its length minus the stretches SponsorBlock skips - and the seconds boxes are gone from the configuration page, replaced by a readout that says what it found. And LiteTV now uses the plugins beside it rather than guessing: it reports which of them are installed at /LiteTv/Plugins, and suggestions are scored by the Smart Similar plugin through /LiteTv/Suggestions/Scored, falling back to a deliberately rough genre match - and saying so - when that plugin is not there.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
